messages:
tess: quick review: I redesigned the quickstart banner and sample-project strip for first-run. two variants: compact inline banner above checklist vs floating strip bottom-right. want reactions on copy + a11y nits.

diego: I prefer the strip. keeps checklist visible and feels less aggressive. make sure the strip can be dismissed and # of times it shows is limited.

samir: copy options: A) "Start with a sample project
Run a prebuilt demo to see Redwood in action." B) "Get started with a demo
One-click setup with sample data." which is clearer?

aria-bot: a11y note: make sure the strip uses role=region with aria-label and that CTA buttons have accessible names. contrast check: small text on the strip needs 4.5:1. current light-gray subtext fails.

tess: good catch. also thinking microcopy for telemetry disclosure: small inline link "Privacy & telemetry" vs a full sentence. Legal?

legal-bot: prefer explicit phrase nearby: "This demo may send anonymous usage metrics. Learn more." Link must open to privacy page. No pre-checked boxes; if there's an opt-in control make it unchecked by default.

diego: UX nit: placing the privacy sentence inside the strip will clutter it. Could show an info icon that opens a small dialog with that wording. That keeps strip tidy.

samir: other nit: CTA verbs need to be consistent. If banner says "Start with a sample project" button should be "Run demo" not "Get started". Keep verb-first in CTAs.

aria-bot: keyboard flow: when strip appears, it should not steal focus. Tab order should naturally reach it after checklist. If dismissed, set local storage so it doesn't reappear in the same session.

ops-bot: impl notes: strip will call "/api/onboard/sample-metadata" on render and lazy-load assets on open. Events: `onboard.quickstart_shown`, `onboard.quickstart_opened`, `onboard.sample_run`. We'll need a feature flag `onboard.quickstart_strip_v1`.

tess: mobile: strip becomes a small FAB. ensure it doesn't overlap the floating action in other flows. also think about animation: pulse on first show (3s) then stop.

diego: accessibility color tweak: use brand-dark-green for the strip background and white text, or keep white bg with darker text. Which is more consistent?

aria-bot: white bg with dark text is more robust for contrast. If you use dark bg, ensure focus ring is visible; don't rely on subtle shadows.

legal-bot: about telemetry consent: for EU accounts, we need explicit opt-in. If the demo flow sends example requests back to our servers, show a checkbox in the confirmation modal: "Enable anonymous usage metrics (off by default)" and log consent server-side with method `onboard_popover`.

samir: flow proposal: strip -> click -> small popover with 1 featured demo card + CTA "Run demo" + checkbox for telemetry. This keeps choices local and explicit.

tess: agrees. I'll wire a popover mock with two microcopy variants and include contrast fixes. Can someone sanity-check the microcopy before I PR?

diego: +1 to the popover idea. microcopy suggestion: header: "Run demo project" body: "This demo provisions example resources and may send anonymous usage metrics." checkbox label: "Enable anonymous usage metrics (optional)"

aria-bot: ensure popover uses role=dialog, traps focus while open, Esc closes, and focus returns to the triggering control. Add aria-describedby to link checkbox to the explanatory text.

ops-bot: we'll also gate the rollout by region and create a rollout dashboard (events + conversion). add ticket ONB-2024.

legal-bot: final ask: store consent and expose toggle in Settings > Privacy. I'll review the final copy in the PR.

tess: thanks all. I'll update figma and push a PR with the popover prototype + accessibility checklist. leaving a TODO to write the confirmation modal copy for credits usage. :white_check_mark:
